feedback: The RM correctly encodes the forced causal chain of ruleset 197 for this task. (1) Ordered coverage: u0->u1 on `purple_star_made` (rule 2 fires on the forward over the yellow pyramid; also covers the putdown variant since the RM keys on the proposition, not the action), u1->u2 on `purple_star_picked_up & blue_pyramid_made`, u2->u3 on `blue_pyramid_on_right`. The conjunction is exactly right: the holding rule fires on the pickup step itself, so both events co-occur on the same step (confirmed by the example trace, step 12), and a purple star can only leave the grid via that pickup, so `blue_pyramid_made` can never occur without it. (2) No same-step chaining hazard: the goal cannot fire on the pickup step (the blue pyramid is in the pocket, not on the right cell) and cannot fire before the pickup, so one transition per step suffices and no milestone is skipped. (3) Constraint compliance: `blue_pyramid_made` and `purple_star_picked_up` cannot precede `purple_star_made`, and `blue_pyramid_on_right` cannot precede `blue_pyramid_made`, so the u0 and u1 else self-loops never swallow a progress event. (4) Irrelevant events (turns, toggle, `red_hex_made`, blocked forwards, neutral putdowns) are all absorbed by the per-state else self-loops in u0, u1, u2; u3's else self-loop is correct since the episode terminates on the goal step. (5) FINAL_STATES header present and nonempty; u3 is declared and accepting. (6) Rewards are dense but bounded and safe: 0.1/0.2 milestone shaping with a final 1.0 on the goal transition, no negatives, no unbounded terms. (7) No regression transitions are needed and none are present: the chain is irreversible (the yellow pyramid is consumed, nothing destroys a purple star except the rule-1 pickup, and the pocket never shows a purple star), so staying in u1/u2 until the next milestone is the right behavior even if the agent maneuvers for many steps. (8) Compact (4 states, minimal for a three-milestone chain) and fully reachable per the seeded example trace; uses only the five supplied propositions with no invented or grid-reading predicates, and respects the event-only semantics by treating every proposition as a one-step trigger rather than a persistent fact.
